name: Balsamic Grilled Chicken & Strawberries with Cucumber-Basil Salad

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 6-12 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (16 oz) pkg strawberries
3 English cucumbers
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim strawberries, thread onto skewers, and place on a large plate; drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper. (If you don't have skewers, you can cook the strawberries directly on the grill pan.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the grill pan is hot, working in batches if necessary, add skewers and cook, turning occasionally, until strawberries are tender and lightly charred, about 4 minutes. Return to the plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil.

Meanwhile, place vinegar in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium-low and simmer until reduced by half, 6-7 minutes; remove balsamic reduction from heat and set aside.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and place on another large plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the strawberries are done, return the grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add chicken and grill until charred and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Add to the plate with the strawberries, re-cover with foil, and set aside.
While the chicken is cooking, place mayo, vinegar, oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; add to the bowl and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chicken, strawberry skewers, and salad between plates; drizzle chicken and berries with balsamic reduction. Enjoy!
